data.body: **[P2] Classify envelope encoding errors as payload failures.** `encodeEnvelope` runs after the offloader task and can throw `SerDesException` when a custom offloader returns a preview value that Jackson cannot encode. Step and wait operations then treat this SDK formatting error as a user-function failure, potentially checkpointing failure or retrying user code. Wrap envelope-encoding failures in `PayloadOffloadException` and add operation tests using a non-serializable preview value.
